Group code by domain or feature, keeping related components, hooks, models, and services together.
Features may depend on shared code, while shared code should avoid feature imports and features should avoid direct dependencies on one another.
Move genuinely general logic used in multiple places into the shared layer.
Keep client boundaries deep in the component tree: server components load data and compose pages, while client components handle interactivity and browser APIs.

concepts.concept: Separation of business logic from routing
concepts.summary: Keep business logic outside route and layout files, with each module having one clear responsibility.
Design features so they can be tested without starting the entire application.

concepts.concept: Component Props as a Public Contract
concepts.summary: Define component APIs with small, explicit props instead of broad objects containing many optional values.
Use controlled components when parents need to know or manage values, and avoid copying props into local state because it creates synchronization problems.
Let visual wrappers accept children so they remain independent of the specific content they contain.
Name event handlers after actions and keep business decisions with the component that owns them, outside generic UI controls.
Use useCallback when stable callback identity matters for a passed dependency, rather than applying it automatically.
Extract reusable components around stable purposes, clear contracts, and multiple real uses; consider composition before abstracting small JSX similarities solely for DRY.

A single source of truth controls dialog opening, rendering, closing, and unmounting.

Triggers, feature services, a shared store, a provider, a renderer, and dialog primitives support dialogs opened from distant application locations.
A discriminated union connects each dialog type to its required props, while unique IDs identify individual open dialogs.
Feature hooks encapsulate dialog content, translations, and callbacks to avoid repeated store calls across triggers.
Closing should remove the correct dialog ID, preserve internal handlers, and precede the confirmation action when appropriate.

TypeScript provides primitive types such as string, number, boolean, null, and undefined.
Prefer type inference by default and add explicit annotations to document contracts, protect public APIs, or support narrowing.
Use type aliases for type compositions and interfaces for extensible or implementable object contracts, maintaining codebase consistency.
Unions of literal types constrain values to specific permitted alternatives more precisely than broad primitive types.
Optional properties may be absent, while required nullable properties must exist but can contain null.
Unknown requires narrowing before use, while any disables type checking and should be isolated to unavoidable boundaries.
Never represents impossible values or functions that cannot return successfully and supports exhaustive switch checks.
The as const assertion preserves literal types and readonly properties, enabling unions derived from constant tuples.

concepts.summary: Generický parametr zachovává vztah mezi vstupním a výstupním typem, například při získání prvního prvku pole.
Zápis <T,> pomáhá parseru v souborech .tsx rozlišit generický parametr od JSX tagu.
Constraint pomocí extends vyžaduje určité vlastnosti generického typu, přičemž dovoluje další vlastnosti navíc.

concepts.concept: Typově bezpečný přístup k vlastnostem pomocí keyof a T[K]
concepts.summary: K extends keyof T omezuje klíč na klíče objektu a indexed access type T[K] určuje odpovídající typ hodnoty.
Generický parametr může mít výchozí typ, například unknown, který usnadňuje použití, ale nemá zakrývat chybějící typovou informaci.
Generická komponenta Select propojuje typ položek options s typy parametrů callbacků getValue, getLabel a onChange.
Generika mají zachovávat důležité vztahy mezi typy; konkrétní typ, explicitní union nebo unknown s narrowing mohou být srozumitelnější.
Narrowing refines a broad type into a more specific variant based on conditions, enabling access to variant-specific properties.
Checks using typeof narrow union types to primitive types such as string or number within control-flow branches.
A shared property with distinct literal values lets TypeScript identify each union variant and its available properties.
Functions returning a type predicate such as value is SomeType enable narrowing through custom runtime checks, whose correctness the implementation must ensure.

concepts.concept: Property Validation with in and Null Checks
concepts.summary: An unknown value can be validated by checking that it is a non-null object, that a property exists using in, and that the property has the expected type.
Passing an unhandled union variant to an assertNever function exposes incomplete switch statements when new variants are added.
Odvozují nové typy z existujících a snižují duplicitu, aniž by měly skrývat důležitý business kontrakt.
Upravují volitelnost nebo zapisovatelnost vlastností; Partial se hodí pro patch requesty, ale nenahrazuje přesný typ formuláře.
Vytvářejí typy výběrem nebo vynecháním vlastností, pokud výsledný kontrakt skutečně představuje podmnožinu původního.
Kontroluje úplnost klíčů objektového literálu a odhaluje překlepy v klíčích podle zadaného typu.
Odvozují návratový typ a typ parametrů z funkce, jejíž signatura slouží jako zdroj pravdy.
Filtrují členy union typů odstraněním null a undefined, výběrem odpovídajících členů nebo jejich vyloučením.
Odvozuje typ výsledku asynchronní operace a lze jej kombinovat s ReturnType pro získání výsledného typu async funkce.
Vlastní utility typ má smysl pro opakující se pattern, jehož pojmenování zlepší čitelnost; přednost mají standardní utility, indexed access nebo satisfies.
Extract property types with T[K] or an array element type with (typeof OPTIONS)[number].
Create new types by iterating over the keys of an existing type and transforming their property types.
Select a resulting type using the condition T extends U ? A : B.
Capture part of a matched type inside a conditional type, such as the value wrapped by a Promise.
Conditional types with a naked type parameter can distribute over union members, offering flexibility at a potential readability cost.
Construct string types from literal combinations to model event names, route patterns, and configuration keys.
Validate a value against a target type while preserving its specific inferred type, including concrete keys and literals in the shown as const pattern.
Describe multiple public call signatures for one implementation, using overloads when they improve the API over a simpler union.
TypeScript typy nezaručují strukturu externích dat; data z HTTP, JSON či dalších vstupů je nutné ověřit za běhu.
Datový tok vede od neznámého vstupu přes runtime parser a validovaný API model k mapperu a UI či doménovému modelu.

concepts.concept: Zod schema jako zdroj validace a typu
concepts.summary: Zod schema definuje runtime validaci a pomocí z.infer poskytuje TypeScript typ, čímž předchází rozcházení definic.
parse při nevalidních datech vyhodí výjimku, zatímco safeParse vrací výsledek umožňující explicitní zpracování chyby či fallbacku.

concepts.concept: Request mapper a oddělení datových modelů
concepts.summary: Samostatný mapper převádí formulářový model na API request a soustřeďuje normalizaci, transformaci a explicitní API kontrakt mimo JSX event handlery.
Zachycené chyby je vhodné chápat jako unknown a před přístupem k message je zúžit, protože vyhozená hodnota nemusí být instancí Error.

concepts.concept: TypeScript Strict Mode and Null Safety
concepts.summary: Enable strict mode to catch problems early; strictNullChecks prevents null and undefined from being automatically compatible with every type.
Choose target, module, and moduleResolution to match the runtime and bundler instead of copying compiler settings without understanding their effects.
Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess so potentially missing array elements include undefined in their type and require appropriate handling.
include selects project source files, while exclude does not prevent imported files from entering the TypeScript program.
Use project references for multiple independently built TypeScript projects; a single well-configured tsconfig is simpler for an ordinary application.
Coordinate TypeScript path aliases with the bundler, test runner, and editor tooling because tsconfig aliases alone do not change runtime resolution.
Run tsc --noEmit in CI to verify types, alongside linting and formatting, which address different concerns and do not replace compiler checks.

concepts.concept: Discriminated unions for valid state modeling
concepts.summary: Model mutually exclusive states with discriminated unions to prevent invalid combinations of flags and associated data.
Type assertions do not validate or transform data; external inputs require a runtime parser, schema, or genuine type guard.
Use satisfies to check type compatibility while preserving inference instead of relying on assertions that can conceal errors.
Use as const for literal narrowing and readonly typing in constant configurations, maps, and value lists rather than as an automatic mutability fix.
Distinguish unchecked any, check-before-use unknown, and uninhabited never; prefer unknown at application boundaries and contain justified uses of any.

concepts.concept: Single source of truth for type contracts
concepts.summary: Prevent schemas, response interfaces, and UI types from drifting by establishing one authoritative contract and deriving or mapping other representations.
Use conditional types, mapped types, and generics when they provide meaningful safety while remaining readable, and simplify unnecessary complexity.

concepts.concept: Role-based naming for types and conversion functions
concepts.summary: Use consistent names that distinguish models, forms, responses, status unions, runtime schemas, parsers, mappers, and type guards.
Combine as const and satisfies to preserve literal types while checking configuration structure, then derive valid keys with keyof typeof.
Use satisfies Record<Status, string> to check that a label dictionary covers every member of a status union.
Represent idle, loading, success, and error states with a discriminated union whose success variant carries generic data.
Use a type predicate and a non-null object check to narrow unknown values to Record<string, unknown>.
Pass an unhandled discriminated-union value to an assertNever helper to enforce exhaustive switch handling.
Distinguish values sharing the same runtime type using compile-time brands, while recognizing that branding provides no runtime validation.
Combine K extends keyof T with T[K] to constrain a property-update helper to valid keys and their corresponding value types.
Check snippets for copy-paste usability, explicit adaptation points, justified any usage, named exports, and clearly identified runtime boundaries.
TypeScript checks code during development or builds; external data requires a runtime schema or parser, and types should be derived from that source of truth.

concepts.concept: Unknown Types, Narrowing, and Type Guards
concepts.summary: Treat external values as unknown instead of any, then narrow or validate them before use.
Represent values with multiple possible variants using a union and a discriminant.
Use generics when an algorithm, helper, or component needs to work with multiple types.

concepts.concept: Deriving Types with Utility Types and Indexed Access
concepts.summary: Derive new types from existing types using utility types or indexed access instead of duplicating their structure.
Use conditional types when a resulting type depends on a condition, while keeping the type definition readable.

concepts.concept: Configuration Objects with as const satisfies
concepts.summary: The guide recommends as const satisfies Shape for configuration objects.
TypeScript project setup includes strict mode, module resolution, and project references configured through tsconfig.
